text_block_list.text:
The "Fan Appreciation Festival,"
held for all the Umamusume fans.
For that event, T.M. Opera O was planning a special performance. And that was—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: An opera, of course! An operetta!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
With an all-star lineup of our peers, we've gotta make our appeal:
'Our generation is right here!'

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And the leading role of the King is—
naturally, played by me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And in the role of Knight A, the King's right hand—
Meisho Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... I'll do... my best!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Playing the role of Opera O-san's ally...
I'm happy, but... uuuh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
To be honest... there was another role I wanted to play...
Auu...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And another subordinate.
Playing the role of Knight B is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It's Admire Vega, also known as Ayabe-san!
We haven't seen each other since the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'm only resting... because I have to.
I just can't seem to get my strength back...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
“Still, is this really okay...?
I haven't even been able to run in races, and yet I'm doing theater...”

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san's role is that of a knight who betrays me midway through and beats me to a pulp.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, I'll do it.

And so, the curtain rose on
their three-person opera show!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! With this T.M. Opera O and
two other individuals here, the kingdom's future is bright!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Shake off the darkness of the previous generation
that continues to shroud the country—!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Shake it off, I say...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The darkness of the previous generation... Grass Wonder-san and the others...
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ahead of them, I...
Auu... Auuuuughhh...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, Ayabe-san.
It's finally time for the betrayal scene.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: She boldly declared our parting of ways and became my enemy.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Okay... Well then...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, how naive, Opera O.
Failing to notice the traitor within your own ranks...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Your rivals aren't the previous generation.
Your true opponents are...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: It's meeeeeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh? Doto?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Was there a line like that?
Don't tell me... an ad-lib!? By Doto...!?

"Faced with such an unexpected turn of events, even
TM Opera O is frozen in place."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I've always... always thought about it...
That I want to compl... compete with you, Opera O-san!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Before, when you reached out to me,
I couldn't respond... and gave up the role...
of your partner to Ayabe-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I was so sad, so terribly sad... I just
wanted you to look at me, even a little... That's why...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I practiced so much. I ran in so many races.
And now... I'm finally just one step away
from a GⅠ...!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I might not make it in time for the next Tenno Sho (Spring).
But...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "At the Takarazuka Kinen! I definitely will at the Takarazuka Kinen!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I want to run with Opera O-san! This time,
as a worthy opponent for Opera O-san...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: So... pleeeeaaase!!!!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Doto, are you...

It was a cry straight from the heart.
Feelings kept bottled up for so long finally burst forth as her voice...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oho, how could this be! To think Doto, whom I trusted as an ally, would betray me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Where has our ironclad solidarity gone?!
It's over... our generation is finished!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Before we even fight the top dogs, we're already falling apart!
Oh, my goooood!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyawawaaa, Opera O-san,
I'm so sorry~! I, I just, ummm~~~!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a pitiable girl I am...!
And yet, however...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
F-Fufufu... This too is fate...
The work of the cursed royal bloodline!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Then come at me, Doto! I, T.M. Opera O, shall neither run nor hide!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Let us begin,
the civil war that divides the kingdom in two!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fwaaaah!? Are you mad, or
are you happy, which one is it~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I think it's best not to worry about it too much...
This person just lives her life in between theatrical performances.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Doto, I'll be... rooting for you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
All that effort... it probably won't go to waste.
Because...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I'm finally set free.
Phew... At last, the baton has been passed...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto, now that you have declared it, there is no turning
back. Indeed, you too are now one of my foes!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"A rift has formed in our generation, but...
It cannot be helped."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Before you take on the previous generation,
you're welcome to challenge me first!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! Opera O,
please guide meee!
(WOOOOAAAHH!!)

With the appearance of an unexpected villain,
the opera show became quite a hit. And then—
Quelling an unexpected revolt within our ranks became a major mission before facing the previous generation.
(Murmur, murmur, murmur, murmur...)
A brief incident caused a stir in the audience.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, don't tell me this isn't an act
and they're genuinely fighting?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: No way!! Picking a fight with Ope when she's blowing up right now? All the Ope stans are gonna be livid, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... Everyone's staring at me...
What is... this? Hauuu...
The moment they realized it wasn't an act, harsh glares were directed straight at Meisho Doto.

T.M. Opera O has been gaining fervent fans lately.
However, that popularity comes back to bite her...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Auuuugh... I'm so sorry...
I'm so... so...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-If I'm being too cheeky, then maybe...
we should just keep things... the way they've always been...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Don't back down, Dotooooo!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, Opera O-san...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You stepped to the front of the stage by your own choice, didn't you?
If so—!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You must never back down! Have courage!
Step onto the stage of this era as a true knight!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And to my fans...
—You are pathetic!

TM Opera O turned toward
the audience with resolute determination.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I want you to love my rivals as well. If you are my fan,
I want you to have a heart as broad as mine.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Don't you agree? A play where an unexpected character
doesn't rise to prominence is utterly boring!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Yes, Meisho Doto is both my friend and my rival..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Just like those of the previous generation standing before us,
I want to be embraced as part of this story!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, may fortune favor all actors who grace the stage
of this magnificent era—!!"
(WAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Way to go, Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Fan D
text_block_list.text: Woo-hoo! The star of the show!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O-san...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto, now that you have declared it,
there is no turning back.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Before you take on the previous generation,
you're welcome to challenge me first!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! Opera O,
please guide meee!

With regal majesty, T.M. Opera O brought the stage
to a grand finale. And then—
Settling scores with the classmates who had stepped forward became a major mission before facing the previous generation.
